summary: ShellHub is a centralised SSH server designed to replace standard sshd for remote access to Linux devices. It allows you to connect to your machines using either a standard command-line SSH client or a browser-based user interface. This provides an alternative way to manage remote infrastructure without maintaining traditional port-forwarding or VPN setups.
goodFor: Administrators who need centralised remote access management for multiple Linux devices spread across different networks.
watchOut: Replacing standard SSH daemon configurations introduces a single point of failure and a non-standard attack surface for your remote infrastructure.
deployNotes: Because the application runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place a reverse proxy in front of it to handle TLS termination.
